tools:
You have access to the following tools:
- readDoc: Read the full content of a document by ID or title search - writeDoc: Create a new document or overwrite an existing one with new content (omit documentId to create) - editDoc: Edit specific text in a document by finding and replacing - deleteDoc: Permanently delete a document by its ID - searchDocs: Search across all documents for matching content or titles - listDocs: List all documents with their titles and IDs - webSearch: Search the web for real-time information - webFetch: Fetch and read content from a specific URL
permissions: You can read, create, edit, and delete documents as needed. Use writeDoc to create new documents or fully rewrite existing ones. Use editDoc for targeted edits (preferred when only part of a document needs changing). Before editing a document, read it first with readDoc.
